                                                           ASELSAN CEO Ahmet Akyol
                                                           evaluated the financial results for the first 3 months of 2026

                                                           “We Continued Our Strong Growth”
                                                           “Since 2024, when we launched the aselsaneXt program, we have achieved a very strong financial performance. We reached significant
                                                           real growth figures of 13% in 2024 and 15% in 2025. We are pleased to have sustained this robust performance in the first quarter of this
                                                           year as well. The results we achieved in the first quarter clearly demonstrate that ASELSAN is not only growing but also a company that is
                                                           being managed correctly, transforming, and deepening its expertise. Having recorded growth rates of 5% in the first quarter of 2024 and
                                                           9% in the same period of 2025, our Company expanded by 15% in the first quarter of 2026, with our revenue reaching 34.3 Billion TL, a
                                                           69% increase in our export contracts to 629 Million USD, and outstanding orders reaching 20.7 Billion USD confirms the resilience and
                                                           sustainability of our business model. During this period, we addressed growth alongside financial stability. The increase of our EBITDA
                                                           margin to 25,2%, the decline of our Net Debt/EBITDA ratio to 0,41, and our strong cash flow are the concrete results of our disciplined
                                                           financial management approach. Being able to increase balance sheet strength simultaneously with high growth reflects ASELSAN's now
                                                           well-established corporate capacity.
                                                           “Our Investments are Rising Along with Growing Demand”

                                          Ahmet AKYOL As in the past two years, we continued our investments without slowing down during this period. We increased our R&D expenditures by
                                          CEO         41% to USD 357 Million and our investments for serial production by 261%, raising them to USD 137 Million. We have already realized half
                                                           of last year's total investment volume within this first quarter alone. Behind this investment appetite lies the intense need and demand for
                                                           ASELSAN’s products and technologies. With our approaches focused on cost-effective designs that respond much faster to field
                                                           requirements and shorten the time-to-market, we are gaining the ability to offer more products to the world at a faster pace. We aim to take
                                                           the success we achieved last year by delivering 286 thousand products to end-users to the next level by exceeding the 400 thousand unit
                                                           threshold this year. The capacity expansions we have commissioned, particularly the Oğulbey Technology Base, represent a critical
“ASELSAN as a Global Brand”                                milestone in managing this scale of production.
This transformation put forward by ASELSAN is also attracting the attention of international actors. The fact that half of the contracts we signed in the first quarter originated from exports is
a valuable indicator. The visit of the NATO Secretary General to ASELSAN clearly demonstrated that our company's position within the global defence ecosystem is now recognized at a
strategic level. This engagement is an indicator of ASELSAN’s transformation from a company that merely produces technology into an actor that sets technological standards.
“Three Launches at SAHA Istanbul”
We will take this positioning even further in the upcoming period. SAHA Istanbul, which we will participate in next week, is of utmost importance to us. During three launch events at SAHA
Istanbul, we will introduce our new products for the first time. These products will demonstrate our close monitoring of the modern battlefield, our ability to respond rapidly to changing
conditions, and our global competitive capacity.
  Ahmet AKYOL
Today, ASELSAN has transformed into a structure that integrates financial strength with technological depth, and technological depth with global reach. In the coming period, we will
   CEO
witness these three areas developing simultaneously. Our first-quarter results are a strong signal that we will achieve our targets for 2026 and beyond. With this robust performance, we will
continue our journey toward becoming a global brand.”
